title: Safety and Efficacy of Human Regular U-500 Insulin Administered by Continuous Subcutaneous Insulin Infusion vs Multiple Daily Injections in Subjects With Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus
trialStatus: Historical trial (protocol estimated first visit Oct 2015, last visit Dec 2016; results published). Confirm status on the registry.

source.protocolDocument: Protocol B5K-MC-IBHD, approved 11-Jun-2015 (Prot_003.pdf, uploaded on the registry record)
source.checkedAgainst: Protocol sections 2, 7, 8 and 9. Attachment 1 (Study Schedule, p.74) and Attachment 2 (Lab Tests, p.78) NOT yet read.
source.note: Re-read the protocol yourself before presenting. Anything marked needs_verification is not confirmed.

site.name: Adult Endocrinology Consultants
site.note: Confirm this site is in the registry Locations list and copy its street address. The real trial was multicenter, so this is ONE site used as the demo scenario.

socialLensExclusions: Irregular sleep/wake cycle, e.g. night-shift work (exclusion 16)
Intends an extended fast during the study, including for religious reasons (exclusion 17)
Hearing or vision impairment that interferes with safe pump use (exclusion 22)
Unable or unwilling to perform procedures independently; no proxy allowed (exclusion 28)
population.simAssumption: ACS/PUMS has no diabetes or insulin-dose variable. Villagers are a general adult population proxy; real participants are a much narrower subset. Say this in the assumptions panel.

schedule.note: Visits 1, 2 and 4 (screening, lead-in, randomization) are inferred to be in person. Visit 3, visit length and weekday-only are not stated in what was read; check Attachment 1. Leave null and treat as assumptions in the sim until confirmed.

fasting.basis: Fasting plasma glucose is measured by the central lab; the fasting instruction for visits itself was not seen.

onsiteLabs.basis: Central lab HbA1c and FPG plus clinical labs. Which visits include blood draws is in Attachments 1 and 2.

selfMonitoring.sevenPointProfile: On any 2 non-consecutive days in the 2 weeks before visits specified in the schedule
selfMonitoring.overnight0300Check: Within 48 hours of each insulin dose increase at telephone and office visits (preferably the first night after the change); also one point in each 7-point profile. Not required every night.

armDifferences.CSII: OmniPod U-500 pump. Training at Visits 5 and 6. Pod changed every 2 to 3 days.
armDifferences.MDI: U-500R three times daily with a U-100 syringe, with a dose conversion (divide by 5).
armDifferences.simAssumption: Participants are randomized 1:1, so burden differs by arm. The sim uses one arm-agnostic 'typical participant'. State this.

deviceComplexity.basis: ASSUMPTION, not a protocol fact. Both arms involve a non-trivial device or dose conversion.

publishedOutcomes.caveat: Completion among screened, selected participants at trial sites, not a general-population dropout rate. Use only as a baseline calibration anchor.
